summary: Tested new features: chatrooms, forums, personals, hotwife, and contest (Pretty Pussy of the Week). All 10 backend pytest cases passed (100%). All 5 new frontend pages render and display data correctly when authenticated. Identified one real auth-persistence bug: /api/auth/login does NOT set the session_token cookie, and App.js does NOT restore the Authorization header from localStorage on app boot — so a hard page refresh or opening the app in a new tab logs the user out even though localStorage still has a valid JWT. Also identified navigation gap: the top nav exposes only Dashboard/Members/Hot Wife/Contest; Chatrooms, Forums, and Personals are not reachable via nav links.

integration_issues.flow: Session persistence on page refresh / direct URL navigation
integration_issues.issue: POST /api/auth/login returns a JWT in the body and the LoginPage stores it in localStorage and sets axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization']. However, /api/auth/login does NOT call response.set_cookie('session_token', ...) (only the Google /auth/google/session endpoint does). On a hard refresh or new tab, App.js calls GET /api/auth/me with withCredentials:true only (no cookie, no header restored from localStorage) → 401 → user redirected to /login. The fix is either (a) add response.set_cookie('session_token', token, httponly=True, samesite='none', secure=True) inside the login() handler in server.py, or (b) on app boot, read token from localStorage and set axios.defaults.headers.common.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`.

Navigation component shows only Dashboard, Members, Hot Wife, Contest. Chatrooms, Forums, Personals routes exist but have no nav links — users can only reach them via dashboard quick actions or direct URLs.

issues: No data-testid attributes on ChatroomsPage.js, ForumsPage.js, PersonalsPage.js — only ContestPage and HotWifePage have them. Recommend adding data-testid to buttons, modals, and list items for these three pages.

action_items: FIX session persistence: add response.set_cookie('session_token', token, ...) in /api/auth/login OR restore axios Authorization header from localStorage on app boot in /app/frontend/src/App.js.
Add Chatrooms / Forums / Personals links to the top Navigation component so users can discover them.
Add data-testid attributes to interactive elements in ChatroomsPage.js, ForumsPage.js, PersonalsPage.js for future automated testing.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatroomCreate has no Pydantic length validation — empty name/description accepted; consider min_length=1.
send_chatroom_message reuses ForumPostCreate model — confusing naming; consider a ChatroomMessageCreate model.

GET /api/chatrooms/{id}/messages returns messages sorted DESC and limited, which is fine for polling, but frontend should reverse or sort ASC for chronological display — verify ChatroomsPage handles this.

Vote endpoint uses $addToSet inside a separate find_one('voters') check — race-condition safe but not atomic; under high concurrency two simultaneous votes from same user could both pass the check. Acceptable for MVP.

/api/contest/winner only looks at the immediately previous ISO week; if no entries existed last week (as is the case now) the spotlight will always be null until the second week of operation — by design, but document it.
server.py is 1439 lines — past the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers per feature (chatrooms_router.py, contest_router.py, etc.).
seed_data_creation: Tests created: chatrooms (TEST_Room_*), forums (TEST_Forum_*), personals (TEST_*), hotwife posts (later deleted), one contest entry for primary user this week (2026-W21). One vote from a freshly registered user on the primary user's contest entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend new feature endpoints are all 100% green via /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py. The main outstanding issue is session persistence on hard refresh — login endpoint does not set a session_token cookie and App.js does not rehydrate the Authorization header from localStorage. Once the main agent fixes this, retest by doing page.goto on /chatrooms etc. without manually injecting Authorization header — they should render. The primary test user already has a contest entry for week 2026-W21, so any further attempt to POST /api/contest/entries by this user will return 400 'You already submitted this week' — use a fresh user for that scenario.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of session persistence bug: server.py login() at line ~280 returns {token, user_id} but never calls response.set_cookie. Frontend LoginPage stores the JWT in localStorage and sets axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] — but axios.defaults is JS in-memory state, not persisted. On a fresh page load App.js immediately calls GET /api/auth/me with withCredentials:true only. There is no session_token cookie (because login never set one) and there is no Authorization header (because axios.defaults was reset on the new page load). The /api/auth/me endpoint therefore returns 401 and the user is bounced to /login. Reproduction: login, then refresh — you land on /login. Mitigation: set the cookie in /api/auth/login the same way /api/auth/google/session does it, OR add a top-level useEffect in App.js (before ProtectedRoute mounts) that does: const t = localStorage.getItem('token'); if (t) axios.defaults.headers.common.Authorization = `Bearer ${t}`;
